description: This file contains unit tests for the I18NService class, part of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It tests various functionalities including translation collection retrieval, cache key generation, language switching, and translation translation, ensuring correct behavior of internationalization features.

classes.name: I18NServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of the I18NService class in the OrangeHRM system, covering translation retrieval, caching, language management, and translation rendering.

methods.name: testGetI18NDao
methods.description: Verifies that the getI18NDao method in I18NService returns an instance of I18NDao.

methods.name: testGetTranslator
methods.description: Checks that getTranslator returns a Translator object with the correct locale, and that it can perform translations as expected.

methods.name: testGetTranslationCollection
methods.description: Ensures that obtaining a translation collection for a language results in correct key-source-target mappings.

methods.name: testGenerateCacheKeyPrefixForLang
methods.description: Validates the generation of cache key prefixes for specified languages.

methods.name: testGenerateTranslationCacheKey
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of generating translation cache keys.

methods.name: testGenerateTranslationKeyTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Checks cache key generation for translation key-target arrays.

methods.name: testGenerateTranslationSourceTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Tests cache key creation for source-target translation mapping arrays.

methods.name: testGenerateETagCacheKey
methods.description: Verifies the cache key generation for ETag values based on language code.

methods.name: testGetETagByLangCode
methods.description: Ensures the ETag retrieval for a language code is correctly cached and consistent.

methods.name: testGetETagByLangCodeWithMultipleLanguages
methods.description: Checks that ETags are correctly fetched and cached for multiple language codes.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesAsJsonString
methods.description: Validates the JSON string output of translation messages for a given language.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesKeyTargetArray
methods.description: Tests retrieval of translation messages as a key-target array for a language.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesKeyTargetArrayWithInCaseNotCreatedCache
methods.description: Ensures cache invalidation triggers re-fetching of translation messages when cache is cleared.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesSourceTargetArray
methods.description: Checks the source-target array of translation messages for correctness.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesSourceTargetArrayWithInCaseNotCreatedCache
methods.description: Verifies re-fetching behavior for source-target message array when cache is cleared.

methods.name: testTrans
methods.description: Tests translation of specific keys, including parameter substitution, across default and specified languages.

methods.name: testTransWithMultipleLanguages
methods.description: Checks translation behavior across multiple language datasets and language switching.

methods.name: testTransBySource
methods.description: Verifies translation by original source string, with fallback to source if translation not available.

methods.name: getMockI18NDao
methods.description: Creates a mock I18NDao returning specified translation messages, used for testing translation-related methods.
